title: 2026 Kiwanis Kids Christmas Shopping
seo_title: 2026 Kiwanis Kids Christmas Shopping in Lebanon, MO
description: This is the annual Kiwanis Kids Christmas Shopping event, where volunteers are invited to help during the 2026 holiday season. Organizers ask people to sign up in advance through the sign-up link so they know they have enough helpers. It takes place on December 1, 2026 (Time TBD) at Walmart Lebanon on S Jefferson Ave in Lebanon, MO, and admission is free.
